items.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences

items.title: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API
items.content: Fast, focused, low-cost decisions for any application.
items.contentSnippet: Fast, focused, low-cost decisions for any application.

summaries.zh: 使用决策API构建更响应迅速的应用。该API提供快速、专注且低成本的决策支持，适用于各类应用程序。
summaries.en: The Decisions API enables developers to create more responsive applications by providing fast, focused, and low-cost decision-making capabilities. It is designed to streamline the integration of decision logic into any application, enhancing performance and efficiency. The API offers a scalable solution for handling complex decisions, making it suitable for a wide range of use cases. Its simplicity and cost-effectiveness make it an attractive option for developers seeking to optimize their app's decision-making processes.

items.title: What FDE means at OpenAI
items.content: What forward deployed engineering means at OpenAI
items.contentSnippet: What forward deployed engineering means at OpenAI

summaries.zh: OpenAI的“前哨部署工程”是指将工程团队直接派往项目现场，以快速响应需求、解决问题并加速开发进程。这种模式有助于提高效率，确保技术方案与实际应用紧密结合。
summaries.en: **Summary:** Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) at OpenAI refers to a specialized team that works closely with researchers and product teams to translate cutting-edge AI research into practical, scalable solutions. FDE engineers focus on deploying models in real-world applications, ensuring they meet performance, reliability, and safety standards. The role bridges the gap between theoretical advancements and operational deployment, supporting OpenAI's mission to develop and deploy beneficial AI technologies.

items.title: How AT&T is rethinking in-house legal work with OpenAI
items.content: AT&T is working with OpenAI to make legal knowledge easier to access. Learn how its LegalEdge team is rethinking intake and scaling legal judgment.
items.contentSnippet: AT&T is working with OpenAI to make legal knowledge easier to access. Learn how its LegalEdge team is rethinking intake and scaling legal judgment.

summaries.zh: AT&T与OpenAI合作，旨在提升内部法律工作的效率。其LegalEdge团队通过引入新技术，重新设计案件受理流程，并扩大法律判断的规模，以实现法律知识的便捷获取。此举旨在优化内部法律服务，提高工作效率。
summaries.en: AT&T collaborates with OpenAI to enhance access to legal knowledge. The LegalEdge team is redesigning intake processes and expanding legal judgment capabilities through this partnership. The initiative aims to streamline legal operations and improve efficiency.

items.title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
items.content: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, available through Google Cloud Marketplace.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, available through Google Cloud Marketplace.

summaries.zh: OpenAI与Google Cloud合作，将前沿模型和Codex工作流程引入Gemini模型花园，并通过Google Cloud Marketplace提供。这些服务现已在市场上可用，旨在为用户带来更强大的AI功能和开发工具。
summaries.en: OpenAI and Google Cloud are integrating OpenAI models, including frontier models and Codex workflows, into Gemini’s Model Garden. The integration is part of a broader effort to provide enterprise-grade AI solutions.
